en:
Sound

Introduction

The Sound functions play built-in VEXcode sounds through the computer running VEXcode that the V5 Brain is connected to.

Below is a list of all functions:

Actions — Play sounds.

  • playVexcodeSound — Play a built-in VEXcode sound through the computer.

Actions

playVexcodeSound

playVexcodeSound plays a built-in VEXcode sound through the computer running VEXcode that the V5 Brain is connected to.

Usage:
playVexcodeSound(sound);

Parameter Type Description
sound const char* The sound to play: "game over".

Return Value:
This function does not return a value.

// Play the game over sound
playVexcodeSound("game over");
